name: NGC 7371, PS15bgt field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7371, the host galaxy of the Type Ib supernova PS15bgt, seen by Hubble.
label: ps15bgt-hubble
story: In this galaxy the supernova PS15bgt, a Type Ib explosion, burst into view and was even picked up in radio waves. Hubble came back to the site in a snapshot survey of recent, nearby supernovae, looking for lingering light and the stars around each explosion.

claims.text: PS15bgt is a Type Ib supernova in the galaxy NGC 7371, also designated PSN J22460504-1059484
Radio emission was detected from PS15bgt
Hubble observed the site in a snapshot survey of the sites of recent, nearby supernovae, aiming at late-time light and the local stellar environment
